text:
**STEP 1 - Scene:** This is a breakfast plate with scrambled eggs, one strip of bacon, pineapple chunks, raspberries, blueberries and chia pudding.

**STEP 2 - Vessel:** The plate is a white square dinner plate, about 25 cm per side. Because it is square, I used side² instead of the circle formula: area ≈ 625 cm².

**STEP 3 - Items:**
- scrambled eggs
- bacon strip
- pineapple chunks
- raspberries
- blueberries
- chia pudding

No sauce or oil is visible.

**STEP 4 - Area:**

| Item | Share of plate |
|---|---|
| Eggs | 22% |
| Bacon | 4% |
| Pineapple | 10% |
| Chia pudding | 8% |
| Berries | 7% |
| **Total covered** | **~51%** |

The plate is about half covered, so these shares are consistent.

**STEP 5–7 - Volume, grams and energy:**

| Item | Area | Height | Volume | Density | Grams | kcal/100 g | kcal |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Scrambled eggs | 137 cm² | 1.5 cm | 206 ml | 0.65 | 134 g | 150 | 201 |
| Bacon (thin strip) | 25 cm² | 0.4 cm | 10 ml | 1.0 | 10 g | 540 | 54 |
| Pineapple | 62 cm² | 2 cm | 125 ml | 0.6 | 75 g | 50 | 38 |
| Chia pudding | 50 cm² | 1.5 cm | 75 ml | 1.0 | 75 g | 100 | 75 |
| Berries | 44 cm² | 2 cm | 88 ml | 0.55 | 48 g | — | 26 |

- For the eggs, I used a density of 0.65, below the 0.9–1.0 egg range in the guide, because these scrambled curds are fluffy and loose.
- The berries split into about 25 g raspberries at 52 kcal/100 g (13 kcal) and 23 g blueberries at 57 kcal/100 g (13 kcal).

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** The total is about 342 g and 394 kcal. That is plausible for a moderate breakfast plate that is about half covered.
